methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $43M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
FleetZero is a Series A transportation company founded by Steven Henderson and Mike Carter that has raised $43M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of six private frontier-tech peers in transportation, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, REGENT Craft, and Beyond Aero. No public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable approach, given insufficient narrow-peer datapoints for a meaningful median analysis. Using $43M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier between Series A and the next financing stage yields $86M. The peer-median approach was not applied due to absence of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier matches within the transportation cohort; relying on all-sector medians would introduce undue noise given the sector's capital intensity and stage heterogeneity.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $73M (low) to $99M (high), with a median of $86M. Key uncertainties center on the appropriateness of the 2.0x step-up multiplier absent recent comparable Series A-to-B transactions in this subsector, and on whether the private comp set (six peers across wide valuation tiers) adequately reflects FleetZero's specific risk profile and market position. Updated comparable financings or evidence of revenue traction would strengthen conviction in this range.
